SHENZHEN, China, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- RLX Technology Inc. ("RLX Technology" or the "Company") (NYSE: RLX), a leading global branded e-vapor company, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.

Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights

  • Net revenues were RMB1,916.6 million (US$285.9 million) in the third quarter of 2026, increasing by 69.7% from RMB1,129.3 million in the same period of 2025.
  • Gross profit increased by 26.7% to RMB446.6 million (US$66.6 million) in the third quarter of 2026.
  • Gross margin was 23.3% in the third quarter of 2026, compared with 31.2% in the same period of 2025, primarily due to a change in the revenue mix following the consolidation of the Company's newly acquired European entity.
  • Non-GAAP income from operations[1] was RMB143.8 million (US$21.4 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB187.8 million in the same period of 2025.
  • U.S. GAAP net income was RMB147.1 million (US$21.9 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB206.8 million in the same period of 2025.
  • Non-GAAP net income[1] was RMB235.6 million (US$35.1 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB295.4 million in the same period of 2025.

"The third quarter marked a defining inflection point for RLX as we integrated our newly acquired European distribution platform with our existing retail footprint, evolving into a leading global smoke-free brand," said Ms. Ying (Kate) Wang, Co-founder, Chairperson, and Chief Executive Officer of RLX Technology. "We now possess end-to-end capabilities spanning global product innovation, supply chain execution, and direct route-to-market reach, while always placing our brands at the heart of adult consumers' choices worldwide. By pairing these strengths with dedicated local field teams and an open, multi-brand ecosystem philosophy, we are gaining sharper retail insights that will empower us to tailor products to local consumer preferences, scale our multi-category portfolio, and capture market share as shifting global regulations reshape the industry."

Mr. Chao Lu, Chief Financial Officer of RLX Technology, commented, "We delivered strong third quarter financial results, with the consolidation driving a surge in net revenues to RMB1.92 billion, up 69.7% year over year. International markets contributed 86.5% of our top line. While our blended gross margin now reflects the consolidation of the distribution business, we maintained solid non-GAAP profitability, improved working capital efficiency, and achieved a healthy sequential rebound in operating cash flow. Looking ahead, we are actively lifting our European platform's margins through supply chain optimization and capital deployment, while navigating transitional working capital needs related to the UK's October introduction of an excise duty. Supported by RMB13.48 billion in total financial assets, we have the financial flexibility to fund global brand expansion, deliver long-term sustainable growth, and maintain strong shareholder returns."

Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

Net revenues were RMB1,916.6 million (US$285.9 million) in the third quarter of 2026, increasing by 69.7% from RMB1,129.3 million in the same period of 2025. The increase was primarily due to the consolidation of the Company's newly acquired European entity in July 2026. Net revenues from international business represented 86.5% of net revenues for the period.

Gross profit was RMB446.6 million (US$66.6 million) in the third quarter of 2026, increasing by 26.7% from RMB352.6 million in the same period of 2025.

Gross margin was 23.3% in the third quarter of 2026, compared with 31.2% in the same period of 2025, primarily due to a change in the revenue mix following the consolidation of the Company's newly acquired European entity.

Operating expenses were RMB407.1 million (US$60.7 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB259.3 million in the same period of 2025. The increase was primarily due to higher salary and welfare expenses and increased shipping and logistics costs.

Selling expenses were RMB182.9 million (US$27.3 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB132.3 million in the same period of 2025, primarily due to increases in salary and welfare expenses and shipping and logistics costs.

General and administrative expenses were RMB185.9 million (US$27.7 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB85.7 million in the same period of 2025, primarily due to higher salary and welfare expenses and legal and other consulting fees.

Research and development expenses were RMB38.3 million (US$5.7 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB41.3 million in the same period of 2025.

U.S. GAAP income from operations was RMB39.5 million (US$5.9 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB93.3 million in the same period of 2025.

Non-GAAP income from operations was RMB143.8 million (US$21.4 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB187.8 million in the same period of 2025.

Income tax expense was RMB43.6 million (US$6.5 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB45.9 million in the same period of 2025.

U.S. GAAP net income was RMB147.1 million (US$21.9 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB206.8 million in the same period of 2025.

Non-GAAP net income was RMB235.6 million (US$35.1 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB295.4 million in the same period of 2025.

U.S. GAAP basic and diluted net income per American depositary share ("ADS") were RMB0.131 (US$0.020) and RMB0.123 (US$0.018), respectively, in the third quarter of 2026, compared with U.S. GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS of RMB0.167 and RMB0.157, respectively, in the same period of 2025.

Non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS[2] were RMB0.186 (US$0.028) and RMB0.175 (US$0.026), respectively, in the third quarter of 2026, compared with non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS of RMB0.236 and RMB0.221, respectively, in the same period of 2025.

[1] Non-GAAP net income and non-GAAP income from operations are non-GAAP financial measures. For more information on the Company's non-GAAP financial measures, please see the section "Non-GAAP Financial Measures" and the table captioned "Unaudited Reconciliation of GAAP and Non-GAAP Results" set forth at the end of this press release.
